description: Coinversa Pulse provides analytics for Hyperliquid markets, including crypto perps (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE) and Hyperliquid's stock and commodity markets (gold, silver, oil, copper, the S&P 500 and US stocks such as NVIDIA, Tesla and Apple). Explore open interest and funding, long/short positioning by trader cohort, liquidation levels, order-book depth and resting stop orders, public-wallet trading activity and position history, and builder revenue. Compare related assets across venues and check the coverage and freshness of available data. It can also watch wallets, price levels, liquidations or a trader cohort's positioning for you: matching events are kept in an inbox in your Coinversa account for 14 days and read back when you ask (paid plans and the trial). Analytics tools are read-only; the inbox tools create and delete your event subscriptions and clear inbox messages once read. Coinversa supports market research and analytics; it does not place orders, sign transactions or transfer funds.
